name: Hanging
description: A four-cell diamond, each cell carrying one of its corners.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); clip-path: polygon(100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(100% 44%, 100% 100%, 44% 100%); clip-path: polygon(100% 44%, 100% 100%, 44% 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: scale(1, 1); transform: scale(1, 1); @match(@x % 2 == 0) { -webkit-transform: scale(-1, 1); transform: scale(-1, 1); } @match(@y % 2 == 0) { -webkit-transform: scale(1, -1); transform: scale(1, -1); } @match(@x % 2 + @y % 2 == 0) { -webkit-transform: scale(-1, -1); transform: scale(-1, -1); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
